name: Never Again!
summary: Never Again! is a Horde strike mission originating from Splintertree Post in Ashenvale. Prompted by intercepted demonic orders, champions are sent to eradicate two Burning Legion dreadlords commanding the hostile forces near the site of Mannoroth's demise.

sections.title: Decapitating the Legion
sections.body: Following the discovery of intercepted invasion schemes, the defenders at Splintertree Post refuse to wait for a demonic assault to materialize. The Burning Legion's lesser minions lack cohesive direction without cunning minds to bind them. By dispatching Gorgannon and Diathorus the Seeker, the Horde aims to shatter the fiends' chain of command before an army can marshal in the southern woods.

sections.title: Shadows over Demon Fall
sections.body: The targets lurk within Demon Fall Canyon and Demon Fall Ridge, the cursed expanse where Grom Hellscream sacrificed his life to slay the pit lord Mannoroth. Gorgannon lingers near the shattered remnants of Mannoroth's spear, while Diathorus makes his redoubt inside an overrun barrow den atop the nearby ridge. Slaying them on the very ground where orcs won their freedom serves as an emphatic declaration that the Horde will never submit to demonic bondage again.

faq.q: Who orders the deaths of these dreadlords?
faq.answer: Valusha, an orc stationed at Splintertree Post in Ashenvale, issues the command after reviewing intercepted demonic battle plans.

faq.q: Why is this mission named 'Never Again!'?
faq.answer: The phrase refers directly to the blood curse that previously enslaved the orcish race to the Burning Legion. Slaying dreadlords in the very canyon where Mannoroth died reaffirms that the Horde will never fall under demonic mastery again.
Gorgannon is located in Demon Fall Canyon south of Felfire Hill, lingering near the shattered pieces of Mannoroth's floating weapon.

faq.q: Where is Diathorus the Seeker located?
faq.answer: Diathorus the Seeker resides inside a barrow den on Demon Fall Ridge, accessible by a trail winding up from the canyon near Grom Hellscream's memorial.

faq.q: What happens to the remaining demons once their commanders fall?
faq.answer: According to Valusha, lesser demonic minions are largely mindless without dreadlord oversight, meaning the loss of Gorgannon and Diathorus effectively neutralizes their coordinated invasion threat.

faq.q: What prior task leads up to this mission?
faq.answer: It is the direct continuation of Diabolical Plans, in which an adventurer intercepts written directives from the demons operating in Ashenvale and brings them to Splintertree Post.

angles.text: Striking down dreadlords on the sacred ground of Grom Hellscream's sacrifice is a profound matter of honor and defiance against the ancient masters who once enslaved the orcish people.
Warlocks who delve into fel secrets must confront the reality of Legion commanders who actively attempt to reclaim servitude over Azeroth's races.
